title: Innocents Abroad; or, The New Pilgrim's Progress
author: Ancient
content:
Innocents Abroad; or, The New Pilgrim's Progress

Published in 1869, this account of a trip east to the Old World was a great popular
        success. Within its first year it sold over 70,000 copies,
        and it remained the best-selling of MT's books throughout
        his lifetime. The book began as a series of travel letters
        written mainly for the Alta California, a San Francisco
        paper that sponsored MT's participation in the 
Quaker
        City
 trip to Europe and the Holy Land in 1867. Revising
        the letters into a book was suggested by Elisha Bliss, who
        published 
Innocents
 as a subscription book on July
        20th, 1869.
